# MeuralMCP

Local control of Netgear Meural Canvas frames: CLI, REST API and MCP server.

This file is a map for agents. The method surface is docs/agents.md — an agent
using the MCP tools does not need the operator material.

## Entry points

- docs/agents.md — MCP tools and REST routes, request/result shapes. Start here.
- README.md — what the project is, quick start.
- docs/deploy.md — operator installation, configuration and service verification.
- docs/sleep-schedules.md — per-device sleep windows.

## Concepts

- Devices are configured by name (canvas-1) with an IP and an orientation.
- Images must match orientation: landscape 16:9, portrait 9:16.
- Images are stored server-side; a frame keeps showing one after reboot.

## MCP tools

list_devices, get_device_status, get_device_image, set_device_image_data,
clear_device_image, publish_device, sleep_device, wake_device,
get_device_schedule, set_device_schedule, clear_device_schedule,
get_device_time, list_device_galleries, get_device_gallery,
create_device_gallery, upload_device_gallery_item, show_device_gallery,
show_device_item, delete_device_gallery, delete_device_item, set_device_picture,
get_device_settings, get_device_settings_schema, update_device_settings,
run_device_action,
get_device_video, get_device_video_storage, list_device_video_galleries,
create_device_video_gallery, get_device_video_gallery,
delete_device_video_gallery, list_device_video_files, get_device_video_file,
delete_device_video_file, upload_device_video_file, download_device_video_file,
play_device_video, stop_device_video.

## Result shape

{"status": "pass", ...} on success; {"status": "failed", "reason": ...} otherwise.
Reasons: device_not_found, image_not_found, image_base64_invalid,
unreadable_image, orientation_mismatch, disabled, invalid_time,
identical_times, unknown_timezone, on_device_api_required.

Settings reads redact credential-like values unless include_sensitive=true.
Immediate picture paths are frame-local. Hardware/network actions and deletes can
be disruptive; see docs/agents.md for exact arguments and REST equivalents.

## Video

Inspect get_device_video for capabilities, fullscreen/overlay layers and storage.
Prepared videos/galleries persist until explicitly deleted. Prepare MP4 H.264
Baseline/YUV420P at the desired size/orientation before upload; no conversion is
performed by the service. Transparent overlays use prepared native-sized `.mvo`
bundles (application/vnd.meural.overlay): MVOZ0001 compressed premultiplied BGRA
with per-pixel alpha. All preparation happens upstream; the frame decodes only.
play_device_video takes exactly one url/file_id/gallery_id; repeat=1 once
(default),0 forever,N full playlist cycles. presentation=auto/fullscreen/overlay.
stop_device_video presentation=all(default)/fullscreen/overlay.
MCP transfer limit:16MiB decoded; prefer raw binary REST upload/download for larger
files. Binary uploads require Content-Length and available storage. Deleting
active files/galleries returns409 until explicitly stopped; gallery deletion
removes its files. Fullscreen restores the original gallery/item on completion,
error or stop; overlay leaves it running underneath. See docs/agents.md for all
13 video tools, routes, exact argument shapes and result/error envelopes.

Prepared fullscreen streams accept HTTP(S)/HLS and RTSP(S) media URLs. The native
decoder must support the actual stream codec/profile; protocol availability is
not playback proof. Transparent prepared-alpha streams require HTTP(S).
